origin.description: Apply the fractional difference operator of order d.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric series of length at least 2.

origin.details: The series is centered before the filter. The weights are 1 and then the cumulative product (k - d - 1) / k. The convolution is an FFT of the next length whose factors are 2, 3, and 5.
origin.value: The differenced series, the same length as x.

translation.description: Apply the fractional difference operator of order d.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric series of length at least 2.

translation.details: The series is centered before the filter. The weights are 1 and then the cumulative product (k - d - 1) / k. The convolution is an FFT of the next length whose factors are 2, 3, and 5.
translation.value: The differenced series, the same length as x.
translation.example: print(list(diffseries([math.sin(i) + 0.3 * math.cos(i / 3) for i in range(1, 41)], 0.25)[:4]))
